newsitem.title: USA: Excite launches online chat features.
newsitem.headline: Excite launches online chat features.

text.p: Excite Inc. said Sunday it is set to launch a new online chat service Monday that enables consumers to know whether friends, family or colleagues are online and to exchange messages with them.

The introduction of Excite PAL, or Personal Access List, across the Excite Network accompanies the launch of the Internet navigation company's new community strategy and the extension of its advertising-based service.
The service carries advertising but is available for free for consumers who register and provide demographic information on their age, gender and zip code.
This can then be used to target advertising towards a particular demographic group or audience, Excite said.

Eric Jorgensen, manager of Excite Communities, said in a statement prepared for Monday's announcement that Excite will be able to provide mass distribution capabilities and will support multiple computer systems.

Although the Internet is still in its infancy as a broad-based commercial consumer network, new features such at those being offered by Excite are aimed at making it a bit more reliable and easier to use.
Excite PAL enables users to instantly communicate with others who are on line. It also allows them to block certain users from knowing they are online, to protect their privacy.

The service expands beyond the chat rooms available for years on the service of its strategic partner America Online, which holds a stake in Excite, along with other online services such as Compuserve, and it brings these capabilities to the Internet.
It also extends into an advertising-based service features similar to those envisioned by Microsoft Corp., Netscape Communications Corp. and International Business Machines Corp.'s Lotus.
Excite said the technology is licensed from Virtual Places and will work on both Apple Computer Inc.'s Macintosh computers and personal computers.
Excite said Excite PAL can be downloaded for free from its People & Chat Channel at http://www.excite.com.
